The nonstandard lower estimate is the corner derivation ||[Z,A]||_{q′}≤2^(1−1/q)||Z||_{q/(q−2)}||A||_q, from the HS corner bound √2 and trace-class bound 2 via bilinear complex interpolation. Pair [W*,A] with B using the Schatten p norming functional, including W=J at p=1, to get the matching lower bound. No finite rank or separability restriction. Independently constructed 15 singular-value tests verify equality witnesses but not infinite-dimensional interpolation.

value.rationale: The product of Schatten norms required to realize a fixed nilpotent as a single commutator is a natural quantitative invariant beyond existence. Its exact universal constant across p, rank and dimension is mathematically motivated and not a routine rescaling of an earlier qualitative theorem.

final_claim: Every complex-Hilbert-space nonzero square-zero T in S_p, 1≤p<∞: inf_{[X,Y]=T}||X||_(2p)||Y||_(2p)=2^(1/(2p)-1)||T||_p, attained with square-zero X and self-adjoint Y.
limitations: Only square-zero targets, not arbitrary nilpotents, normal targets, mixed Schatten exponents or target T=0 beyond trivial cost zero.
The bilinear interpolation lemma relies on standard Schatten corner interpolation and should be independently expert-reviewed; finite tests cannot establish it.
